key_highlights: Energy stocks lifted ASX on rising oil prices; tanker-war concerns failed to suppress crude (Headlines 32, 36)
BHP under pressure as iron ore prices crumble, with reports of strategic restructuring (Headline 33)
Gold sector strong: Forrestania joins 2Moz club, Kaiser restocks Tassie inventory, Larvotto NSW discovery (Headlines 1, 6, 10)
Australian housing price falls accelerate; RBA signals it will not intervene to support property (Headlines 37, 38, 39)
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, signalling structural shift in auto sector (Headlines 49, 50)
Consumer stress deepens: second jobs surge as mortgage costs bite, Australians feel poorer (Headlines 31, 44)
ASX small-cap runners: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche Metals lead weekly gains (Headline 73)
Aureka acquires Victorian mine/mill for $8.9M, signalling junior mining consolidation (Headline 15)

sectors.trend: Divergent: gold producers (Forrestania, Kaiser) and junior explorers (Larvotto, Aureka, Kaoko, Vanadium Resources) outperform; iron ore complex under severe pressure with BHP restructuring
sectors.implications: Rotate from iron ore (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) into gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and critical-minerals juniors; BHP.AX faces margin compression risk

sectors.trend: Oil-driven rally lifts Woodside, Santos, and upstream names; tanker-war geopolitics support price floor but demand concerns linger
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX, and upstream E&P names benefit from elevated crude; monitor OPEC+ output and tanker-war escalation

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA's refusal to ease for property create headwinds for banks' NIM and REIT valuations; consumer credit stress rising
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face rising NPL risk; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from falling rents and occupier stress

sectors.trend: BYD's EV tipping-point claim signals structural disruption to legacy auto; consumer spending squeezed by mortgage costs; AI/tech rally broadening in US
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure; EV adoption accelerates; monitor CSL.AX, SGP.AX as defensive healthcare anchors

sectors.trend: Qantas engine-divert incident and tumbling aviation sentiment; Cramer flags aviation giant as buy opportunity
sectors.implications: QAN.AX short-term volatility; monitor safety record and fuel-cost exposure

RBA's hands-off stance on property market amplifying housing correction
Consumer affordability crisis driving second-job participation
Geopolitical oil risk (tanker wars) supporting energy prices
Junior mining M&A and discovery activity remains active
US midterms and Trump policy threats as external risk factors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / BHP restructuring
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; hedge via gold and critical-minerals positions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA inaction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and property-linked financials; favour dividend-paying defensives (CSL.AX, SGP.AX)
Maintain energy allocation (WDS.AX, STO.AX) as inflation hedge; monitor AUD/USD
Diversify away from US-listed exposure; favour domestic ASX defensives

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer credit stress and rising NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL disclosures; favour CBA.AX over smaller banks with higher consumer exposure

opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser restocking, Larvotto discovery, and ASX small-cap runners signal sector momentum; iron ore weakness supports gold rotation

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil strength
opportunities.rationale: Tanker-war risk and Magnolia's profit doubling support upstream E&P; WDS and STO benefit from elevated crude
Aureka's $8.9M Victorian acquisition signals consolidation; small-cap discovery pipeline active

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and property-linked exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: BHP restructuring on crumbling iron ore; RBA will not rescue property; housing falls accelerating

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase defensive healthcare and staples allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer stress and affordability crisis favour CSL, SGP, WES as resilient dividend payers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and monitor RBA commentary
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA's refusal to ease for property may keep rates elevated; AUD vulnerable to iron ore weakness

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold outperform, iron ore and property lag. RBA's hawkish stance on property limits rate-cut expectations. Oil volatility from tanker-war risk adds upside to energy names. Consumer stress data may pressure retail and bank sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore dependency toward gold, critical minerals, and energy transition (EVs). Housing correction may extend 6–12 months absent RBA intervention. BYD's EV tipping point accelerates auto-sector disruption. AI/tech broadening in US may lift ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) on sentiment spillover.

Australian CPI and retail sales data
OPEC+ output decisions and tanker-war escalation
BYD and EV market-share data in Australia

ASX 200 sector rotation (materials vs energy vs financials)
US S&P 500 and AI-stock momentum (spillover to ASX tech)
